status: post-outcome required-revision specification frozen before the S05 protected execution
purpose: Separate auxiliary-Webb conditioning, support expansion under the primary raw beta cutoffs, and reclassification after recomputing cutoffs on the broader beta-valid support.

scientific_contract.outcome: CPS employment-stock share of workers aged 22-25 relative to workers aged 26-65
scientific_contract.calendar: 113 observed Basic CPS months from 2017-01 through 2026-07, excluding 2022-12 and unavailable 2025-10
scientific_contract.objective: frequency-weighted grouped-binomial likelihood with occupation and month fixed effects
scientific_contract.broader_support_rule: positive 2017-01 through 2022-11 corrected preperiod stock in both age groups and finite strict Rule-A beta; Webb availability is not required

models_in_fixed_order.classification: apply the four fixed primary raw-beta cut values to every broader-support occupation
recompute employment-weighted raw-beta cuts on broader support

ordered_interpretation: primary_with_webb to primary_without_webb isolates Webb conditioning on identical support and labels
primary_without_webb to broader_fixed_primary_cuts_without_webb isolates support expansion while preserving the primary raw cut values
broader_fixed_primary_cuts_without_webb to broader_recomputed_cuts_without_webb isolates reclassification on identical broader support
scientific_contract.support_change_inference: The primary-to-broader coefficient movement changes the estimation population and is descriptive; do not report it as an equivalence or same-estimand paired test.
scientific_contract.direct_tail_definition: A family directly supports Q5-versus-Q1 only when that family contains at least one positive-preperiod-stock occupation in each tail under the stated support and classification rule.

inference.interval: 95 percent occupation wild-score interval using common Rademacher draws within an identical ordered support
inference.null_interval_interpretation: does not detect a difference; never economic equivalence

numerical_validation.candidate: existing frozen grouped-logit fixed-effect engine used for scientific estimates and occupation influence
numerical_validation.reference: independent zero-start damped sparse Newton implementation from the authorized A1 numerical module on the same grouped-binomial objective

privacy.allowed: occupation-level memberships, preperiod stock aggregates and shares, coefficient/inference summaries, numerical diagnostics, and hashes
